title: skills-sh-coreyhaines31-marketingskills-onboarding-cro
summary: # Onboarding Experiment Ideas Comprehensive list of A/B tests and experiments for user onboarding and activation. ## Contents - Flow Simplification Experiments (reduce friction, step sequencing, progress & motivation) - Guided Experience Experiments (product tours, CTA optimization, UI guidance) - Personalization Experiments (user segmentation, dynamic content) - Quick Wins & Engagement Experiments (time-to-value, motivation mechanics, support & help) - Email & Multi-Channel Experiments (onboarding emails, email content, feedback loops) - Re-engagement Experiments (stalled user recovery, return experience) - Technical & UX Experiments (performance, mobile onboarding, accessibility)
type: skills
